I think a 45-minute technical kickoff is the right first step. Proposed agenda (attached):

Can you confirm if Thurs 6/5 10:30 PT works? If not, I can do Fri 6/6 10:00 PT.

Initial answers inline:
- Prefix KV caching: supported for hosted + Dedicated; for Private we need to enable it in the runtime config — Karthik will include the ops checklist in the kickoff.
- 4-bit quantization: we have a recommended profile that usually preserves chat-quality for Alpaca-style models; we will surface model-specific guidance after we see Alliant's weights and perf traces.
- Network egress: Private on-prem clusters must allow outbound to our control-plane endpoints on 443; we can run a firewall-friendly mode but will need a small NAT flow for telemetry.

I attached a short kickoff agenda PDF and added Karthik and Kimberly to help with validation planning.

Thanks for the context — adding a few technical notes ahead of the kickoff so security and ops can review early: 

Validation matrix (high level):
- Connectivity: control-plane (443) outbound to api.redwood.com + registry endpoints. If egress is fully restricted, we can flip to an offline-key mode but that requires a brief manual bootstrap and rw token exchange.
- Runtime features: prefix KV caching can be toggled per-service; sustained throughput tests should include "warmup" to populate caches.
- Quantization: 4-bit supported; we recommend the q4_0 profile for Llama2 variants and running a small A/B eval on representative prompts — expect a 2–4% degradation vs fp16 on generation metrics in worst-case, but often imperceptible.
- Latency target: for streaming workloads with avg 120 tokens/request we should plan for Dedicated capacity during production; sandbox runs on a single A10-style host may not meet p95 targets.

Test plan (short):
1) Sandbox deploy (private) with NVLink disabled to emulate customer on-prem resources — 2 days
2) Load-based metric sweep: tokens per second, p50/p95 latency, throughput; record KV cache hit rates — 2 days
3) Quality regression: run customers' prompt set vs baseline fp16 — 1 day
4) Signoff and runbook handoff — 1 day

I'll bring a sample runbook and the firewall IP ranges to kickoff. Kimberly, can you prepare the observability packet (dashboard + token-cost template)?

Karthik Iyer
